description:
benchbox-site has browser acceptance scripts that passed in the Astro build PR (core #2606) but run in no workflow; site ci.yml runs only vitest and the Explorer Playwright suite.
- website/e2e/shell.mjs: axe at 1280, 390 and 320 px in both themes, 44 px targets, theme persistence, Pagefind docs and blog search.
- website/e2e/parity.mjs: axe over every page template and a Pagefind smoke search.
- website/e2e/not-found.mjs: deep links and query-string URLs through the 404 fallback on a Pages-like server.
- website/e2e/explorer.mjs: shell parity, back and forward, query-string restore, worker and WASM recovery, zero Explorer bytes on docs and blog pages.
- website/e2e/landing.mjs: composer filter and copy, no third-party scripts on /, axe on / and /prompts/. Part of it compares against the legacy static landing/ tree, which astro-site-54 removes.
- explorer/e2e/routes/pages-artifact.spec.ts: Pages-shaped direct routes, skipped unless E2E_PAGES_SHAPED and E2E_SITE_DIR are set.

Add a CI job that builds the site from the fetched bundle and runs these checks against website/dist. Drop the parts of landing.mjs that need the legacy landing/ tree. These criteria come from astro-site-22, 35, 36 and 40, which were dropped as delivered.
